title: [EXA-19] Smaller example and definition mismatches
description:
Review finding EXA-19: Smaller example and definition mismatches (lens EXA). Location: spec/02-identity.md:107; spec/07-compliance.md:267; spec/14-jmap.md:111, 132, 158; spec/10-relays.md:55, 213; spec/13-encoding.md:76; spec/09-interop.md:121, 147. Fix: All seven sub-points check out. Two corrections:
  - 07:267: name the signer as `loggerDID`, not `admittedBy`. 07:276 and 07:299 make the logger the writer of the compliance audit chain.
  - MXID: `@agora_<did-fragment>` fails even for `did:key`. Matrix localparts must be lowercase (`a-z0-9._=-/+`), and `z6Mk...` contains uppercase letters. Use a lowercase base32 encoding of a hash of the full DID.
  - 10:55 is resolved together with EXA-7. Full text: notes/review/EXA-verified.md and notes/review/EXA.md.
